extra_decisions.what the ink shows: The tall stem is followed by several superposed loops and descending arms. The order of the overwriting cannot be recovered; lower case is contextually natural but not fully secured by these strokes.

notes: Sparse continuation of the Kummer notes: a map from the fundamental group of S with geometric base point to a limit of roots of unity, then a displayed inertia sequence and the parallel-stroke identification of the residue-field and valuation-ring groups. The lower half is blank apart from pencil foliation 3; no date. The sequence is recorded as an assertion, not proved here.

The upper limit uses the quoted abbreviated phrase “prem à S”. No characteristic or invertibility condition is supplied in the transcription. The tail-bar arrow is retained literally; an exact-sequence convention does not replace it by a hooked inclusion. The residue letter is overwritten, so its lower/upper case remains doubtful.
hand: On 141002 and 004 the pen makes long loose descenders and retraces k/K. The upper S here has two bends, while the base-point s is a small curved stroke; this supports S in the limit condition. H expands prem on both occurrences and géométr. on this page; the short forms are retained. Overwriting prevents extending the case distinction to the residue-field argument.
